biotools.summary: This tool visualizes a disease-disease network augmented with genetic correlations derived from clinical biomarkers, allowing users to explore connections between diseases and associated biomarkers. The network is based on UK Biobank data and aims to improve understanding of genetic associations in cardiometabolic disorders.
